/**
 * @name Code injection via eval/exec/compile
 * @description Using eval, exec, or compile with potentially untrusted input can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/code-injection-eval
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::builtin(["eval", "exec", "compile", "__import__"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("importlib").getMember("import_module").getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe code execution operation that could execute arbitrary code."
findings.hypothesis: Check for dangerous code execution functions like eval, exec, compile, or dynamic imports that could lead to code injection

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Uncontrolled recursion depth
 * @description Recursive functions without depth limits can lead to stack overflow DoS
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/uncontrolled-recursion
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-674
 */

import python

from Function func, Call call
where
  call.getScope() = func and
  call.getFunc().(Name).getId() = func.getName() and
  not exists(If ifstmt | ifstmt.getScope() = func and ifstmt.getTest() instanceof Compare)
select func, "Recursive function '" + func.getName() + "' may lack depth control, risking stack overflow."
findings.hypothesis: Check for recursive functions without proper depth control that could lead to stack overflow DoS

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Uncontrolled recursion in decoder
 * @description Recursive functions without depth limits can cause stack exhaustion
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/uncontrolled-recursion
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-674
 *        external/cwe/cwe-400
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from Function func, Call call
where
  // Find recursive calls
  call.getScope() = func and
  call.getFunc().(Name).getId() = func.getName() and
  // In decoder files
  func.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath().matches("%decoder%") and
  // No obvious depth check in the function
  not exists(Compare cmp |
    cmp.getScope() = func and
    cmp.getASubExpression().(Name).getId().toLowerCase().matches("%depth%")
  )
select call, "Recursive call in decoder without apparent depth limit may cause stack exhaustion."
findings.hypothesis: Uncontrolled recursion in decoder that could lead to stack exhaustion DoS

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unchecked buffer access
 * @description Accessing buffer or array without bounds checking
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/unchecked-buffer-access
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-125
 *        external/cwe/cwe-129
 */

import python

from Subscript sub, Name arr
where
  arr = sub.getObject() and
  (
    arr.getId().toLowerCase().matches("%substrate%") or
    arr.getId().toLowerCase().matches("%buffer%") or
    arr.getId().toLowerCase().matches("%octets%") or
    arr.getId().toLowerCase().matches("%stream%")
  ) and
  sub.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath().matches("%decoder%") and
  // Check if index is a variable (not a constant)
  sub.getIndex() instanceof Name
select sub, "Buffer access on '" + arr.getId() + "' without apparent bounds checking."
findings.hypothesis: Unchecked array/buffer access that could lead to out-of-bounds read

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Potential infinite loop in decoder
 * @description Loops in decoder that may not terminate with malformed input
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/decoder-infinite-loop
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-835
 */

import python

from While loop, Function func
where
  func.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath().matches("%decoder%") and
  loop.getScope() = func and
  loop.getTest().(Compare).getOp(0) instanceof Lt
select loop, "While loop in decoder " + func.getName() + " may not have proper termination checks"
findings.hypothesis: Check for potential DoS through unbounded loops in decoder without proper length validation

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Length field without maximum validation
 * @description Parsing length fields without maximum bounds can lead to resource exhaustion
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/unbounded-length-field
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-770
 *        external/cwe/cwe-400
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, Expr arg
where
  call.getFunction().asExpr().(Attribute).getName() in ["read", "fromfile"] and
  call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath().matches("%decoder%") and
  arg = call.getArg(0).asExpr() and
  not exists(Compare cmp | 
    cmp.getASubExpression*() = arg and
    cmp.getOp(0) instanceof Lt
  )
select call, "Reading data with length " + arg.toString() + " without maximum bounds check"
findings.hypothesis: Look for length field parsing without maximum size validation that could lead to DoS

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name OID decoding without shift bounds checking
 * @description OID decoding performs unbounded left shifts that can cause resource exhaustion
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/oid-unbounded-shift
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-400
 *        external/cwe/cwe-834
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from BinaryExpr shift, While loop
where
  shift.getOp() instanceof LShift and
  shift.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath().matches("%decoder%") and
  loop.getBody().contains(shift) and
  exists(Compare cmp |
    loop.getTest() = cmp and
    cmp.getOp(0) instanceof GtE
  ) and
  not exists(Compare bound |
    loop.getBody().contains(bound) and
    bound.getASubExpression().(Name).getId() = shift.getLeft().(Name).getId()
  )
select shift, "Unbounded left shift in OID decoding loop at line " + shift.getLocation().getStartLine().toString()
findings.hypothesis: OID decoding allows unbounded shift operations that could cause CPU exhaustion through crafted input with many continuation bytes
